title: Single-Incision Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Versus Traditional Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: This study will compare Single Incision Laparoscopic Surgery (SILS) cholecystectomy to traditional laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC), focusing on patient-reported outcomes and cost.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient recommended to undergo cholecystectomy
* Patient age 18-80
* Patient competent to give his/her own informed consent
* Patient speaks English without the need for an interpreter

Exclusion Criteria:

* Additional procedures planned during same surgery
* Patient deemed inappropriate for TLC or SILS cholecystectomy
